subject: Request: Week-long keepalive while PO routes through procurement
messages:
From: Ari Cohen <ari.cohen@brightforge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: temporary keepalive while PO routes through procurement

Hi Naomi / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the BrightForge engineering team is excited by the throughput numbers and the dev ergonomics. We're in final stages with internal procurement but the PO routing is taking longer than expected (legal + vendor validation).

Can Redwood provide a one-week keepalive (sandbox/top-up or temporary voucher) so we can keep the pilot running while procurement finishes? We expect the PO to be approved by next Friday (12/31). If helpful, I attached the PO draft and a short note from procurement.

What would you need from our side to make that happen quickly?

Thanks,
Ari
Ari Cohen
Head of Platform
BrightForge
Attachments: BrightForge_PO_draft.pdf (stub)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ari Cohen <ari.cohen@brightforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary keepalive while PO routes through procurement

Hi Ari — appreciate the quick update and for sharing the PO draft.

We can usually offer a short keepalive in cases like this. A few quick asks so we can expedite:
- Confirm expected PO approval date (you said 12/31 — is that internal target or committed date?)
- Confirm whether the sandbox usage is limited to integration/dev team only (vs. production data).
- Any procurement contact we should copy for the paperwork?

I’ll loop Marissa and David for capacity and approvals; if they OK it we can provision a 7-calendar-day voucher tied to your account and draft the short addendum (no charge if PO arrives by the deadline).

—Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-21T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary keepalive while PO routes through procurement

Naomi — thanks for flagging. Internal note: policy allows up to 7 days of sandbox/top-up credits for procurement-in-flight scenarios provided the sales owner documents the PO timeline and we attach a conditional addendum (no charge if PO is signed by the end date).

Proposal: issue a 7-calendar-day voucher for 50,000 generation tokens and preserve the current dev seat allocations. Require BrightForge to provide the final PO or a committed approval email by 2026-12-31 COB. If PO misses that date we will invoice for consumed usage.

I've attached the approval-template docx we use for the operations ticket. If David confirms capacity I can raise the Ops ticket and create the voucher code.

Attachments: approval-template.docx (stub)

—Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-21T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary keepalive while PO routes through procurement

Marissa / Naomi — OK to proceed. Please create voucher BF-7DAY-NAOMI-001 for BrightForge for 50,000 tokens, valid 2026-12-22 through 2026-12-28 (inclusive). Conditions: PO must be uploaded and reference deal BF-2026-0781 by 2026-12-31 23:59 PT; finance to reconcile once PO is received.

I added the HubSpot link to the deal for record-keeping. Marissa — please raise the Ops ticket and notify customer when voucher is created.

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Sales Operations
david_kim@redwood.com

This is perfect — thank you. We accept the conditional voucher and will ensure PO BF-2026-0781 is routed and uploaded to your finance contact by 12/31 COB.

I'll upload the signed PO draft once legal completes the final redline (attached as a placeholder). Appreciate the quick help — this keeps our integration sprint on schedule.

Best,
Ari
